subject: High School OPM Selection Committee Formation
overview: The building committee met to advance the high school project by forming a selection committee for an Owner's Project Manager and providing updates on enrollment studies. The communications subcommittee also planned for website updates, community outreach surveys, and student-produced video tours of the current facility.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from the July 17 full committee meeting.

items.title: Enrollment Study and Documentation Update
items.summary: The committee reported on a meeting with the MSBA regarding enrollment projections and provided additional housing market data to justify a project sized for 1,500 high school students. Documentation regarding maintenance, capital planning, and enrollment projections will be posted to the district website in a digestible format.

items.title: Timeline and Building Tours
items.summary: The committee announced upcoming tours of recently completed high schools in Arlington, Waltham, Somerville, Stoneham, and Billerica to gain inspiration for the design phase.

items.title: OPM Selection Committee Formation
items.summary: Approved the formation of an Owner's Project Manager (OPM) Selection Committee to manage the upcoming public procurement and help lead the project into the feasibility study phase. The approved members include Jenny Graham, Libby Brown, Peter Cushing, Aaron Olapade, John McLaughlin, Fiona Maxwell, and Bob Dickinson.

items.title: Communications and Community Engagement Strategy
items.summary: The subcommittee introduced new Communications Director Will Pipicelli and discussed prioritizing substantive content on the project website before moving to more professional design elements. Maria Dorsey reported that vocational film and television students are interested in producing a video tour highlighting the current high school's physical deficits.

items.title: Community and Board Surveys
items.summary: The subcommittee planned a five-question survey for city boards and commissions to coordinate presentations, while deferring a general community FAQ survey until mid-November to avoid noise from other ongoing district issues.

items.title: District Updates and MSBA Logo Contest
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent announced that project updates will be included in weekly district emails and noted that local students will participate in an MSBA re-branding logo contest.
